notes.title: GOING FTP!
notes.content: [p]Or, going free-to-read, rather. BAPTISM over 8 years old now; I made it in college as practice and now I think its time to let it exist as an artifact of my artistic process-- freely available. It will not receive any updates, nor will its story be continued in any meaningful way (probably) but I thank everyone who left reviews in the past (as those who are brave enough to review in the future) as this project was a big learning step for me as a kid. This was my first Kickstarter! My first video game! My first "published" piece of work![/p][p][/p][p]I'm working on MUCH bigger and better things now, but I hope you all enjoy if you are a new or returning reader, and please be on the look out for future games! [/p][p][/p][p]Keywords for things in progress: RPGMAKER and TTRPG.[/p][p][/p][p]-Sam[/p]

notes.title: Steam Release and Gumroad Link
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you so much for checking out this game! As you can probably already tell, it's release day for the Steam version of this game. This game is also available on Gumroad (link posted below), for those who would prefer that. Just a warning though, the Gumroad version WILL NOT support updates, or at least not as often as the Steam version will. 

I hope you all enjoy the game! Thank you to the wonderful people on Kickstarter who made this project possible!

GUMROAD DOWNLOAD: https://gum.co/YRlWx

-Samantha Arehart
